description: This Java source file defines the MrpServices class which provides various services for running Materials Requirements Planning (MRP) within the OFBiz manufacturing framework. The class includes methods for initializing MRP events, calculating product quantities on hand, processing bill of material components, and executing the MRP logic to generate procurement and production recommendations.

classes.name: MrpServices
classes.description: A utility class providing services related to Materials Requirements Planning (MRP), including initializing MRP events, computing quantities on hand, processing bill of material components, and running the core MRP algorithm.

methods.name: initMrpEvents
methods.description: Initializes MRP events by clearing old events, removing proposed requirements, and creating new planned events based on order data, requirements, stock levels, and forecasts.

methods.name: findProductMrpQoh
methods.description: Calculates the quantity on hand for a specific product in the context of MRP, considering inventory availability at a facility.

methods.name: logMrpError
methods.description: Logs an error or issue encountered during MRP processing into the MrpEvent entity for tracking.

methods.name: processBomComponent
methods.description: Processes a bill of material (BOM) to create MRP requirement events for each component involved in manufacturing a product.

methods.name: executeMrp
methods.description: Main method to run the MRP process, calculating what products need to be purchased or produced based on demand, inventory, and forecasts, and generating the corresponding events.
